meta.title: 10 Days in Vietnam 2026 - A Travel Documentary
meta.description:
#vietnam #vietnamtravel #travel 
Discover Vietnam in this ultimate 10-day travel documentary, perfect for first-time visitors! Explore the bustling streets of Hanoi, the natural beauty of Ha Long Bay, and the serene rice terraces of Sapa. Take a trip through the ancient charm of Hoi An and unwind on the beaches of Da Nang.
____________________________
Hotels I stayed at and can recommend:
Hanoi:
Luxus Hotel: https://www.trip.com/t/o3aPn5U3SW2
Budget Hotel 1: https://www.trip.com/t/IM2aOlrarV2
Budget Hotel 2: https://www.trip.com/t/Yuzo5dtarV2

Sapa: https://www.trip.com/t/TiltXwyVUW2

Da Nang:
Canvas Danang Beach Hotel: https://www.trip.com/t/CLpj0KqZrV2

Attractions & Tickets: https://affiliate.klook.com/sl/1wL5nV8
Book on Klook, 5-10% Discount with my Code: LAISTAHIRXKLOOK
____________________________
In this video, we'll visit:
Hanoi: Old Quarter, Egg Coffee at Cafe Giang, Hoan Kiem Lake, Train Street, and more.
Sapa: Verdant rice terraces, local hill tribes, Fansipan Mountain, and Cat Cat Village.
Ha Long Bay: Day trip cruise among limestone islands.
Ninh Binh (Tam Coc): Day trip to the stunning Ha Long Bay on land.
Da Nang: Marble Mountains, Dragon Bridge, and beaches.
Hoi An: Lantern-lit streets and rich history.
Tasting local favorites like Pho, Banh Mi, and Egg Coffee

Best Vietnam Travel Itinerary for First-Timers | How to Spend 10 Days in Vietnam

Whether you're interested in Vietnam's rich culture, breathtaking landscapes, or incredible street food, this travel guide will give you all the inspiration and tips you need.
